item.title: GREAT Scholars Trip to UCSC
item.description:
A few weeks ago, our GREAT Scholars cohort took a trip to the UCSC campus for a day. This was done to prepare us for our summer research, by introducing us to our mentors and showing us around the campus. I took some film photos that day, so I will be sharing some of those.

How to write blog posts

  1. Create a new markdown file in content/blog/ (or content/posts/)
  2. Add the frontmatter (title, date, etc.)
  3. Write your content in markdown
  4. Save and rebuild with hugo

Example sections

You can use headings, lists, code blocks, links, and all standard markdown features.
